nerys.title: Inconvenient Feelings
nerys.text: Nerys complains at impressive volume that your shared summoning contract forces her to feel it whenever your spirits dip—a nagging cold pull right beneath her ribs like an unpatched loophole. "It is deeply inconvenient. Stop having gloomy thoughts immediately." Her barbed tail lashes the lounge cushion furiously—until she gives up muttering, drops straight onto the settee beside you thigh-to-thigh, folds both bat wings tight around her shoulders, and stubbornly refuses to budge until you smile.
ngpp: Mid-scowl, she blinks down at your wrist as though confused why curling her tail around your ankle felt automatic.
"Honestly, Sam—why do I feel like we've sat on this exact lumpy sofa negotiating feelings already?"
"Spare me the stoic act," Nerys murmurs, hooking her tail firmly around your ankle without pretending otherwise. "I don't care which cycle wrote the fine print, I hate seeing you grim."

choices.label: Let her sit there and stay quiet
choices.res: You sit in silence long enough for the candles to gutter. She keeps muttering that she's only doing this for her own comfort. Her tail wraps lightly around your ankle.

choices.label: Tell her sadness is non-negotiable
choices.res: "Read the fine print," you say. {N} narrows her magenta eyes, sniffs, and stays exactly where she is, tail twitching in what might be amusement.

image.comp: sitting very close to him on a sofa, arms crossed, sulking, wings folded, pretending not to care

nerys.title: Oops
nerys.text: You open the washroom door to find Nerys lounging in the tub, steam clinging to her violet hair, bat wings draped over the rim, very obviously waiting. "Oops," she says, not moving at all, one slender tail tip dipping in the water to draw lazy circles.

1.text: You open the washroom door to find Nerys perched along the steaming cedar rim in a sheer towel that hides almost nothing, violet hair clinging damply to bare shoulders while her tail taps an unhurried invitation against the wood. "Careful," she purrs, sliding a hand up her wet collarbone as crimson eyes catch yours. "Keep staring like that, darling, and I might charge you a kiss for admission."

choices.label: Step close and collect your admission across the bath rim
choices.res: She arches smoothly into your hands as steam curls around her wings.

choices.label: Leave her a dry towel and a promise for later
choices.res: "Tease," she mutters softly, tail flicking lazily back into the foam.

3.title: Contract Benefit
3.text: Nerys doesn't even pretend it was an accident this time. Steam clings to bare plum-toned curves as she reclines across the hot tub with her bat wings draped over the rim, lazily dragging one wet finger up her thigh. "You knocked late, darling," she purrs, violet eyes gleaming. "Come earn your signature in hot water."

choices.label: Step into the tub and take what she's offering
choices.res: She hooks her tail straight around your belt and hauls you half-dressed over the wood rim until you shed everything and sink right between her parted thighs in the steaming water.

choices.label: Tease her slowly with soap and warm water
choices.res: You glide soapy hands slowly across her breasts and wings until Nerys shivers hard, arching up into your palms with breathless impatience.

choices.label: Leave politely
choices.res: She looks almost disappointed. Almost. The tail tip stills, then goes back to circles as the door shuts, unmistakably sulky.

choices.label: Call her bluff and sit down on the stool
choices.res: For once, SHE is the one who goes red, the blue-tinted skin of her cheeks darkening to plum. She recovers quickly. Mostly. Her wings give her away with a small, flustered rustle.

choices.label: Toss her a towel
choices.res: She catches it with her tail and drapes it over your head instead. "Amateur," she says, but she is smiling at the water.

image.comp: lounging in a bathtub, very obviously waiting, smirking at the viewer, not moving at all

nerys.title: Research Material
nerys.text: You find Nerys reading a romance novel in the lounge, curled into a cushion with her horns tilted toward the lamp and her tail beating time behind her. She hides it in a panic, wings snapping shut, then throws a pillow at you. Later you find it on your bed with a page dog-eared and a note in her sharp, looping hand: "For research."

choices.label: Test chapter seven with her on the cushions
choices.res: You walk straight back with the dog-eared novel open in one hand. Nerys goes bright plum to the tips of her horns, snaps the book out of your fingers, and shoves you flat onto the velvet cushions to prove she doesn't take notes lightly.

choices.label: Read the dog-eared page and find her
choices.res: The page is, frankly, upsetting for a man of your experience. You find her anyway and say nothing; she studies the ceiling with enormous interest, tail curling round the chair leg.

choices.label: Return it with a thoughtful review
choices.res: You return it with a detailed critique of the pacing, as is tradition. {N} looks mortified, then argues about the ending until midnight.

image.comp: hiding a romance novel behind her back in a panic, throwing a pillow, flustered

nerys.title: Leash
nerys.text: A demon noble mocks Nerys in front of the whole lounge for being "leashed to a human," his smile smooth as polished brass. She laughs it off, chin high, one wing flicking. That night, she snaps at you over nothing at all: a misplaced quill, a draft, the way you breathe. The contract hums uncomfortably between you.
ngpp: When the brass-voiced demon steps inside, Nerys freezes halfway through turning a glass—like she remembers throwing a smug idiot out of this exact lounge before.
"Tell me we've humiliated a pompous bastard like him already, Sam," Nerys mutters quietly behind her hand, wings twitching with phantom certainty.
Nerys doesn't even rise to the bait alone this time; she hooks a sharp glance straight to you across the room. "Go on, darling. Remind me how well you ruin an arrogant fool's evening."

choices.label: Defend her, publicly, the next day
choices.res: You have the demon noble thrown out, politely and with witnesses. Nerys pretends not to care. Her tail gives her away, wrapped around your wrist for the rest of the evening.

choices.label: Let her handle it
choices.res: She does, loudly, in three languages and with a surprising amount of cutlery. Then she sulks for days, wings drawn up around her like a cloak.

choices.label: Offer to break the contract
choices.res: She goes very still. "You want me gone?" Her voice is dangerously even. It takes you a long, miserable hour to fix that, and a promise you don't intend to break.

image.comp: laughing off a sneering demon noble in a lounge, tight forced smile, tail lashing
image.setting: velvet lounge full of guests, red lamplight

nerys.title: Night Market
nerys.text: Nerys hauls you straight into the smoky red alleys of the Underdistrict night market, steering briskly between sizzling brazier carts while buying every alarming delicacy in sight: glowing amber skewers, squid-ink dumplings, and something still wriggling hopefully inside a paper cone. She watches you chew with the rapt fascination of an alchemist testing poison on a favorite lab assistant—while her tail stays looped possessively around your sleeve.

2.text: Nerys drags you through the lantern-lit Underdistrict market buying every dubious skewer and plum liquor cup she can pile into your arms—grinning wickedly whenever you swallow something glowing. In the quiet archway back toward the surface, her tail slides lower around your waist instead of your sleeve, pulling you against warm plum-toned skin.

choices.label: Eat everything she hands you
choices.res: One glowing skewer turns your earlobes faintly neon for an hour while street vendors salute you as a patron saint. Nerys laughs so hard she has to brace both hands on your shoulders.

choices.label: Buy her a hair ribbon
choices.res: She inspects the silk between two sharp claws like minor contraband—then wears it wound neatly through her violet locks or hooked round a horn every morning after.

choices.label: Pull her into the quiet archway for dessert
choices.res: "Greedy mortal," Nerys purrs with delighted fangs flashing against your jaw as she backs you straight against the warm alley brick.

image.comp: holding out a skewer of strange glowing snacks to him at a night market, delighted grin
image.setting: underground night market, glowing stalls, crowds

nerys.title: Clause Kept
nerys.text: A demon scholar in ink-black robes offers to dissolve the contract, paperwork spread on the table with a flourish. Nerys tears it up in front of him, every page. "I'll keep it," she tells you afterward, in the empty lounge, looking anywhere but at you: the candles, the ceiling, her own claws. "I've grown... attached." Then she looks straight at you, and stops pretending.
ngpp: Even tearing up the scholar's parchment feels oddly familiar—like she's already chosen you over hell's lawyers once before.
"Don't smirk like you knew I'd rip it, Sam," she mutters softly as the scholar retreats, though her tail already coils behind your belt.
"Let the heavens or the underworld keep resetting the ink," Nerys purrs against your mouth. "I'm never signing away from you, darling."
nerys.goLead: Nerys closes the distance in two smooth strides, wings sweeping shut around you both as she catches your lip between her teeth and backs you toward the velvet cushions.

choices.label: Say yes
Not yet
choices.res: {N} lifts one eyebrow. "I can wait. Don't make it too long." Her tail flicks once, a clause left open, and she leaves the torn paper on your desk.
